bites.title: One black, many layers
bites.body: Another trick: paint solid black on its own layer, then turn the layer opacity down. A box at 70% value needs black at 30% layer opacity. Value = 100% minus the black's opacity.

bites.title: Ten boxes, many layers
bites.body: New layer ({key:add_new_paint_layer|Insert}), fill a box with black, set that layer's opacity. Repeat. You can put several boxes on one layer if they share an opacity... but none of them do!
bites.hint: Box 2 (11%) needs black at 89%. Box 5 (44%) needs 56%.

bites.title: 12 cleared
bites.body: Layer opacity is non-destructive value: change your mind any time. Lesson 17's shadow layers work exactly like this.
